title: Evaluate the inner value
text: If $$x<0$$ is negative, $$\theta=\arctan(x)$$ falls in the interval $$(-\pi/2,0),$$ which is in the 4th Quadrant.

title: Signs of trig functions in 4th quadrant
text: Which trig functions are positive and which are negative in the 4th Quadrant? \n $$\sin$$ and $$\tan$$ are negative, while $$\cos$$ is positive.
